verdict.rationale: Motion has a live, authenticated REST API with a documented endpoint reference, but the evidence scopes it only to creating, updating and managing projects and tasks. Most UI capabilities (AI calendar rescheduling, meeting booking and templates, notetaker, dashboards, time tracking, workflow builder) have no evidence of API exposure, so full API/UI parity is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: API coverage of calendar, scheduling, meeting booking, notetaker, reports, time tracking and workflow features; any statement of API/UI parity; independent corroboration of API breadth.
